boardProfile.layout: Block Out Level 114 gives you two wrenches and two padlocked blocks, but the real constraint is the four bottom color bars — live quotas, not score decoration. Each wrench unlocks exactly one padlock cluster, and spending the blue wrench on the wrong lock leaves the left cyan bar stuck at `10` with no tool to fix it. The top device counter dropping to `3` is your signal that time is running out.
landmarks: Block Out Level 114 gives you two wrenches and two padlocked blocks, but the real constraint is the four bottom color bars — live quotas, not score decoration.
Each wrench unlocks exactly one padlock cluster, and spending the blue wrench on the wrong lock leaves the left cyan bar stuck at `10` with no tool to fix it.
The top device counter dropping to `3` is your signal that time is running out.

quickTips: Red wrench first on the upper yellow block — it only frees the top half.
The bottom `14` pink bar is the last quota; clear yellow `12` and green `4` before the star cluster.
Think in chain clears. The best move is the one that sets up the next two moves, not just the quickest current match.

steps.title: Move 1
steps.instruction: Tap the red wrench on the upper yellow block to unlock the top pink/yellow cluster.

steps.title: Move 2
steps.instruction: Clear the yellow blocks toward the bottom `12` bar before touching the center pink Z-shape.

steps.title: Move 3
steps.instruction: Peel the left cyan column along the red left arrow until the side counter drops from `15` to `10`.

steps.title: Move 4
steps.instruction: Tap the blue wrench on the green block to unlock the padlocked orange tile in the lower-middle.

steps.title: Move 5
steps.instruction: Feed the green blocks out through the bottom `4` bar and the single blue block through the `1` bar.

steps.title: Move 6
steps.instruction: Break up the pink star cluster on the right and close the bottom `14` pink bar through the green right arrows.

steps.title: Move 7
steps.instruction: Exit the last orange singles once the bottom counters read `7` and `9`.

failurePoints: Spending the blue wrench before the red wrench, leaving the top cluster padlocked.
Clearing the pink star cluster before the yellow `12` bar is satisfied.
